company.name: Nuvo
company.shortDescription: Building the closed-loop B2B network for agentic commerce
company.description:
B2B trade across critical industries will become autonomous.

Nuvo connects suppliers and buyers in a verified network and gives AI agents the context graph to fully automate dual-party workflows across onboarding, ordering, invoicing, and payments, eliminating labor-intensive back-office tasks. We're building the vertically integrated trade clearinghouse from the ground up to transform the largest commerce surface on Earth.

Backed by Sequoia, Spark, Founders Fund, and Index.
